The text recounts the past karmic deed and subsequent spiritual attainment of the elder (thera) Ekañjalika. On SuttaCentral, the poem is indexed under the identifier Tha Ap 277 and is cataloged with translations available across five languages [SuttaCentral].

Furthermore, recurring stock verses or formulaic lines connect segments 3.3–7.1 with several other poems in the Therāpadāna, including the *Avopupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 64), *Ārakkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 226), *Ākāsukkhipiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 263), *Ekasaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 77), *Abyādhikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 227), and *Ñāṇasaññikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 130) [DharmaNexus].
